evidence.title: GitHub - taqui-786/mixcnui: Collection of Nextjs Components

name: Mixcn-UI
summary: Animated React component collection for Next.js apps, installed like shadcn/ui through its own CLI (npx mixui init).
description: A collection of reusable, animation-heavy components for Next.js apps, built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion and installed like shadcn/ui through its own CLI. Documented components: a hacker button that scrambles text on click, an Embla-based carousel, animated floating notifications and a set of loading spinners; the site also lists templates. Docs cover installation, component API, theming and animations.
contains: components installed via CLI: npx mixui init, shadcn-style into a Next.js app
documented set: hacker button, carousel (Embla-based), floating notification, loading spinner
built with React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion
sections: components, templates; docs cover installation, component API, theming, animations
